title: Canonical Note Document
description: Versioned canonical representation of a note for storage, export, and encrypted synchronization. No Swift type names, no platform archives, no local paths, no bookmark bytes. Schema version 1.
$comment: Single format contract for sync, export, and import (FR-031a, clarified 2026-08-07): note-level JSON export/import MUST reuse this schema with round-trip fidelity; import MUST fail closed on unsupported/corrupted envelopes. File-reference blocks export generic metadata only (no bookmark bytes or absolute paths, FR-105). Structured note content is capped at 5 MB before asset payloads (FR-090b, clarified 2026-08-07).

title.description: Optional manual title. null means no manual title; a generated summary is display-only and never stored here.

customColor.description: Hex color (e.g. #RRGGBB) when colorKey is custom; otherwise null.

transparency.description: Background opacity (FR-041a, clarified 2026-08-07): 0.40–1.00 inclusive, 0.05 steps, default 1.00 (opaque). Below 1.00, FR-042 contrast validation runs against the composited background. Field name retained from schema v1; the semantic is opacity.

coverScreenshotBlockId.description: At most one cover screenshot per note; references a screenshot block id.

trashedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601; set on trashing; drives 30-day retention.

parentVersionId.description: Previous version; null for the initial version.

blocks.description: Ordered content blocks. Each block's payload conforms to block-payloads.schema.json.
